text:
Anna Li: quick sync — ran into a weird precedence bug where per-route quota overrides are ignored for service accounts that have a delegated tenant role. repro steps below, short thread

Mike Chen: hmm. can you paste the minimal repro?

Anna Li: yeah. gist: tenant A has global quota 1000/min, route /chat has override 200/min for role 'mobile-internal'. we created a service-account token, delegated role mobile-internal, but traffic still gets limited by 1000/min. seems like routing policy selects route-override but authz layer applies tenant quota last.

Raj Patel: that sounds like ordering bug in the enforcement chain. authz -> routing -> quota vs routing -> quota -> authz? which one should win?

Jess Ortega: product opinion: per-route override should win when a role explicitly grants higher/lower quota for that route. tenant-level should be default fallback. otherwise console UX is confusing.

Samir Desai: agree. from infra POV, we currently evaluate quotas after we resolve effective principal (including impersonation), but before routing policy adjustments are applied for affinity. if the route selection happens later (eg by smart-routing), you can lose the override.

Anna Li: repro config (snip):
```
route: /v1/chat
route_policy:
  priority: role_affinity
  overrides:
    mobile-internal:
      quota_per_minute: 200
tenant_quota: 1000
```

Mike Chen: so the runtime picks target pool based on role_affinity after authn, but quota lookup uses tenant+principal metadata computed earlier. two fixes: make quota lookup consult final route_context, or fold quota into routing decision.

Raj Patel: second option is heavier. prefer consult final route_context. also need telemetry to show which quota key was used in logs/console so customers can debug.

Jess Ortega: +1 on telemetry. Console UX: show applied quota badge on route and on active principal in rollouts and the effective source (route override vs tenant default).

Anna Li: also edgecase: delegated service accounts where delegation preserves original org_id vs swapped org_id. affects quota key namespace. we should canonicalize to use delegated principal for quota lookup.

Samir Desai: I'll prot a change to have quota evaluation accept route_context and principal_context. small risk: perf if we do extra lookups. will add sampling to telemetry and a canary flag.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: quota-eval-route-context canary to eng-platform-prod at 2024-07-30T15:05:00Z :rocket:

Mike Chen: thanks. follow-ups: 1) add console telemetry surface for "quota_resolution" with values [route_override, tenant_default, delegated_principal], 2) update doc blurb in Role editor about quota precedence, 3) add e2e that covers service-account delegation + route override.

Jess Ortega: I'll draft the Role editor copy and a small UI flag to surface effective quota on role detail card.

Anna Li: perfect. I'll open the infra PR and add the e2e. tagging Raj for review on the telemetry schema.

Raj Patel: on it. also please add a short note in the rollout checklist about toggling the canary flag and where to look in logs.

Anna Li: done, thanks team :thumbsup:
